focus: Angle 5: agents, subagents, commands, and goal

label: DSH agent presets are declared Cordis compositions, not files discovered from .skilled/agents; persona text can be mounted through dsh-persona.
DSH supports in-process children and a full DSH SDK child runtime, but the SDK backend requires isolated DSH_HOME and does not support independent child presets.
DSH slash commands are code-registered for interactive adapters; Markdown .skilled/commands files are not auto-loaded and headless has no slash-command adapter.
The native workflow tool runs JavaScript orchestration scripts over subagents, not Markdown command templates.
DSH ships session-persisted goal and interactive plan services but no documented shared spec goal.md bridge; Pi and Hermes use explicit bridges.
A DSH sync layer should generate preset declarations and flattened skill mirrors and separately implement command and packet-goal adapters.
